'''Shotgun Jeff''' is a resident of [[Freeside]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
"Shotgun" Jeff became the bartender for the [[Atomic Wrangler Casino]] sometime between [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2281|2281]] and 2296. 

By his own word, he has been around long enough to observe more than one "change in management" in [[New Vegas]] between the [[New California Republic]], [[Caesar's Legion]], a "robot army" (presumably [[Securitron]]s), and most recently a pack of [[Deathclaw (TV series)|deathclaws]] from [[Quarry Junction]]. He boasts that he will stick around as long as he does not have to pay taxes.<ref>Shotgun Jeff: ''"Guess you saw them Deathclaw things come up from Quarry Junction. They fightin' around the Strip. Big whup. Just another fuckin' round o' change in management's all it is. Like one of 'em merry-go-rounds. NCR. Legion. NCR. Legion. Fuckin' robots. No matter to me. Always somebody tryna tell us what to do. Long as they don't come 'round and charge me taxes, I don't give a fuck."''<br/ >({{FOTV|2|5}})</ref>

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Wrangler]]===
Jeff is at his place behind the bar when [[the Ghoul]] walks in and demands a bottle of [[whiskey]]. He tries to strike up conversation about the current state of affairs in the city (the deathclaws overrunning the [[New Vegas Strip]]), but is firmly told to shut up by his customer and walks away.

===[[The Strip]]===
Jeff goes with several [[Freesider]]s and [[Thaddeus]] after they flee into [[Sonny's Sundries]] when [[Maximus]] is smashed through the gate separating the deathclaws in the [[New Vegas Strip]] from [[Freeside]]. He observes with Thaddeus as Maximus in his [[Ranger power armor]] challenges the creatures and starts killing them; when Thaddeus expresses his indecisiveness about helping his friend, Jeff points out his recent loss of his right arm and questions how he could possibly help. When the mutated ex-squire suggests they go out there and help him, Jeff rejects the idea.

A short time later, seeing Maximus start to take damage from the deathclaws' attacks, Jeff leads the Freesiders in starting a row of [[gambling]], placing bets on when their protector will meet his end with Jeff himself betting 20 caps on him lasting a mere five minutes more. When Thaddeus places his bet of five hundred caps that Maximus will win, Jeff questions if he really has the caps he promised, then watches as Thaddeus reveals his exorbitant stash of [[Sunset Sarsaparilla]] bottle caps to cover his bet, to the others' satisfaction.

Later on, after Maximus is forced to abandon the power armor once it takes too much damage to operate, he is spotted by Jeff through the window as he dons a roulette wheel and pool cue for weapons, causing the bartender to exclaim that Maximus is just a "damn kid." The ex-knight's courage in still facing down the deathclaws inspires Jeff alone to grab a shotgun and try to rally the other Freesiders into finally providing help, but the croupier rejects him in turn, to his chagrin.
